profile_intro: Offer your property services in the DR Professionals directory. Your account access stays the same; only profiles approved by an admin appear publicly.
load_error: We could not load this information.
saved: Draft saved. Submit it when you are ready for review.
withdraw_confirm: Hide your public profile and cancel any pending review? Your saved information will be kept.
withdrawn: Your profile is hidden and any pending review has been cancelled.
preview_empty: Add a name and description to preview your profile.
leave_confirm: Leave this page and discard your unsaved professional profile changes?
discard_confirm: Discard this draft and load the latest saved profile?
conflict: This profile changed in another window. Your draft is still here. Reload the latest version before saving again.
action_error: The change could not be saved. Your draft is still here. Please try again.
published_edits: Your last approved profile stays public while changes are prepared and reviewed.
pending_edits: Saving edits cancels the current review request. Submit again when your changes are ready.
suspended_help: Your profile is hidden by an admin. You can save a draft, but an admin must lift the suspension before you can submit it again.
consent_help: Only the business contact details you enter below will be published. Your login email, payment details and personal account settings are not copied into this profile.
consent: I agree to publish this profile and the business contact details entered here in the public directory after admin approval.
revoke_help: Saving with this box unchecked immediately hides any published profile.
multi_help: Select all that apply, up to {{count}}.
name_help: Add a business / professional name or a contact person's name. Both are public when provided.
description_help: Add a description in at least one language. The other language uses the available description until you add a translation.
contact_help: Enter at least one way for customers to reach you. Include the country code for phone and WhatsApp.
photo_help: Optional JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB. It appears in the directory only after profile approval. Use a photo you have permission to publish.
photo_error: Choose a JPG, PNG or WebP image under 5 MB.
photo_failed: We could not upload this photo. Your other changes are still here.
required_notice: You can save an incomplete draft. Submission needs the following:

issues.business_name: Add a public business, professional or contact person's name.
issues.contact_name: Add a public contact person's name.
issues.areas: Choose at least one area served.
issues.description: Add a description in English or Spanish.
issues.contact: Add a public phone, WhatsApp or business email.
issues.public_phone: Enter a valid public phone number with country code.
issues.public_whatsapp: Enter a WhatsApp number with 7 to 15 digits and country code.
issues.public_email: Enter a valid public business email.
issues.website_url: Enter a valid HTTPS business website without login credentials.
issues.consent: Agree to publish the profile and its business contact details.

review_warning: Directory approval is a profile review. Customers should confirm qualifications, references and terms directly before hiring.
admin_intro: Review applications and control directory visibility. Approval does not change anyone's account role or access to listings and leads.
empty: No professional profiles match these filters.
reason_help: Required when requesting changes or suspending. This message is shown to the account owner, never in the public directory.
reason_required: Enter feedback explaining the requested changes or suspension.
approve_confirm: Approve this submitted version and publish its business contact details in the directory?
reject_confirm: Return this submitted version with your feedback? Any previously approved profile remains public.
suspend_confirm: Hide this professional's public profile until an admin lifts the suspension?
reinstate_confirm: Lift the suspension? The profile stays hidden until it is submitted and approved again.
admin_conflict: This application changed while you were reviewing it. Reload it and review the latest version before taking action.
suspended_approval: Lift the suspension first. A new submission and approval are needed to publish again.
not_pending: Only a submitted profile can be approved or returned for changes.
